clips.name: SHIMMYCELERY base
clips.observations: Authentic cheesy 1990s dance-pop MIDI sound with bright synth brass/lead stabs, electro-toms, and a classic four-on-the-floor beat matching the retro novelty aesthetic cleanly.

clips.name: SHIMMYCELERY base (duplicate)
clips.observations: Identical musical take featuring clean synth percussion, snappy retro MIDI brass hooks, and continuous energetic groove with no speech.

clips.name: WOBBLETOPPURPLE base
clips.observations: Playful 90s dance track featuring bright synth leads, funky bassline, and punchy drum machine groove. Clean mix with zero vocal artifacts.

clips.name: WOBBLETOPPURPLE smile
clips.observations: Consistent upbeat 90s eurodance/novelty MIDI instrumentation with percussive synth bells, steady dance beat, and clear rhythmic structure.

overall: All clips nail the low-budget early 90s computer dance sketch aesthetic with bright MIDI synths, clean rhythmic drive, and completely instrumental, speech-free audio.
